# How to Excel to PDF with Codex MCP and Medux

Learn how to use Codex MCP and Medux to convert an excel (.xlsx) file to pdf, including setup, request fields, tool approval, and results.

## Expected Medux tools

- `medux_excel_to_pdf`

## Prompt

```text
Convert an Excel (.xlsx) file to PDF.
```

## Review before approval

- `input_file_id` (required): Input Excel file id.
- `model_id` (optional): Model Default: excel-to-pdf-default.
- `title` (optional): Optional task title.

## Codex notes

- Use `/mcp` to confirm that Medux and the expected tools are available.
- Workspace paths must point to the intended local inputs and output directory.
- Review any network, shell, or filesystem approval requested during upload, download, or verification.
